summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究一个极简 attention-only Transformer 在“所有 token 都被高斯噪声污染”的 in-context denoising 任务中到底在做什么。核心问题不是提升某个模型指标，而是解释 depth、self-attention residual、long-range skip connection 在统计推断中分别承担什么角色。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在机制层面。它把多层 attention 解释为一种有限样本 empirical Bayes 推断：上下文 token 不是被动记忆，而是在深度方向上形成一个逐步修正的经验先验。这个视角有助于理解 Transformer 为什么能在上下文内从样本分布中抽取任务结构，也把 attention 的粒子动力学、associative memory、score-based denoising 几条线索放到同一个简化任务里。对实际大模型 recipe 的直接指导有限，但对理解 in-context learning、denoising-style pretraining、diffusion LM 与 attention 结构的关系有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法把任务拆成两阶段。第一阶段，多层 self-attention 对一组 noisy particles 做迭代更新，用上下文样本自身构造并修正一个非参数的经验先验。第二阶段，通过保留原始 noisy input 的长程残差，把 noisy token 作为 query，在第一阶段形成的能量景观上做 posterior mean inference。单层 attention 可看作对经验分布做 kernel-weighted posterior mean；增加深度后，粒子分布随层数演化，近似一个 anti-diffusive denoising operator。与只把 attention 看作 memory retrieval 的解释相比，这里补充了 memory pattern 从何而来：它们是由 corrupted context 经深度动力学推出来的。与 score-based denoising 解释相比，这里不依赖显式 noise schedule，而是提出固定 kernel bandwidth 和有限积分时间即可完成有效去噪。
summary.experiments: 主要贡献偏理论。关键结果包括：在 continuous-depth 和 large-context 极限下，self-attention 动力学可近似为作用在粒子系统上的反扩散式去噪流；有效去噪不需要噪声或参数 schedule，有限积分时间满足 T* 约等于 sigma^2/2；给出 sequential posterior-mean recovery theorem，证明在一类 admissible priors A_tau 下，经过 hard truncation 的 particle-flow estimator 在特定顺序极限中可一致收敛到 Bayes posterior mean；并验证 Gaussian priors 属于该类。相较 Bruno et al. 采用 spherical layer norm 保证紧性，这项工作在 R^d 上分析，需要通过 hard truncation 控制动力学稳定性。提供的内容没有显示大规模语言模型实验或具体下游数值提升。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 Introduction 和 Problem Formulation，先抓住两阶段 empirical Bayes 分解。随后看 continuous-depth / mean-field flow 的推导，重点理解 attention 更新如何变成粒子系统的反扩散动力学。理论部分可重点看 posterior-mean recovery theorem、A_tau 的定义、Gaussian prior 验证，以及 hard truncation 为什么必要。预计 30-45 分钟可读出主要思想；若关注 Transformer 机制或 diffusion LM，可进一步精读动力学推导。

summary_en.core_problem: The work asks what a minimal attention-only Transformer is doing in an in-context denoising problem where every token is corrupted by Gaussian noise. The central target is mechanistic: assign precise statistical roles to depth, attention residuals, and long-range skip connections.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is mostly conceptual. The paper frames multilayer attention as finite-sample empirical Bayes inference: the context induces an empirical prior, and depth refines that prior before a posterior-mean denoising step is performed. This gives a clean toy setting for reasoning about in-context learning, denoising objectives, associative-memory views of attention, and the relation between attention dynamics and diffusion-style reverse processes. It is not a direct large-scale training recipe, but it sharpens the language for discussing what information is built in-context across layers.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed interpretation has two stages. In Stage 1, self-attention across layers evolves the corrupted tokens as particles, producing a refined nonparametric approximation to the unknown clean-data prior. In Stage 2, a long-range residual carries the original noisy token as a query, and a final attention operation computes a kernel-weighted posterior mean against the refined particle distribution. A single attention step corresponds to posterior-mean estimation under an empirical distribution; depth turns this empirical distribution into a dynamically refined energy landscape. In the continuous-depth and large-context regime, the dynamics approximate an anti-diffusive denoising flow. A notable distinction from noise-scheduled diffusion views is that the analysis uses a fixed attention bandwidth and a finite integration horizon rather than an explicit noise schedule.
summary_en.experiments: The contribution is primarily theoretical. The paper derives a continuous-time particle-flow view of multilayer attention, connects the flow to denoising and reverse-diffusion behavior, and argues that a finite horizon around T* ≈ sigma^2/2 is sufficient for effective denoising under the model assumptions. It also proves a sequential posterior-mean recovery theorem for an admissible class of priors A_tau, with Gaussian priors verified as members of the class. Because the analysis is carried out on R^d rather than a compact normalized domain, hard truncation and stability estimates are needed to control the dynamics. No large-scale language-model experiments or concrete pretraining performance numbers are present in the provided content.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction and problem formulation first to understand the empirical-Bayes decomposition. Then read the continuous-depth and mean-field sections to see how attention updates become particle dynamics. The most useful technical pieces are the posterior-mean recovery theorem, the definition of A_tau, the Gaussian-prior verification, and the hard-truncation argument. A 30-45 minute pass should be enough for the main idea; the proof details are worth deeper reading for work on attention mechanisms or diffusion-style language modeling.

recommendation.zh: 注意力的贝叶斯解释角度新颖，只看第3节的两阶段统计建模推导即可
recommendation.en: Novel Bayesian interpretation of attention, only read the two-stage statistical modeling derivation in Section 3

paper.title: Energy-Gated Attention: Spectral Salience as an Inductive Bias for Transformer Attention
paper.abstract: Standard transformer attention computes pairwise similarity between queries and keys, treating all tokens as equally salient regardless of their intrinsic informational content. In turbulent fluid dynamics, coherent structures -- the energetically dominant, spatially organized patterns that persist amid background chaos -- carry a disproportionate fraction of total energy and govern all transport. We propose that tokens play an analogous role in transformer attention: informationally dense posit

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要补的是标准 attention 的一个结构性缺口：QK 相似度只回答“哪个 token 和当前 query 相关”，但不回答“哪个 token 自身更有信息量”。作者把这个问题表述为 token-level salience estimation，并尝试把“位置本身的谱能量”作为一种先验引入注意力。对语言建模来说，这对应的是：功能词、重复模式、低信息 filler 不应与句法中心词、形态边界、话语标记在被关注时处于同一地位。论文关心的不是新的预训练流程，而是给 Transformer attention 加一个与 query 无关的 bottom-up 显著性通道。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接影响中等，更多是一个可检验的 attention inductive bias 提案，而不是已经被大规模验证的 recipe。它的价值主要有三点。第一，它把“token 重要性”从 query-conditioned relevance 中拆出来，给 attention 设计提供了一个清楚的分解视角。第二，它尝试把 embedding 沿上下文维度看成信号，再用谱能量去刻画 token 显著性，这和近来把 LLM 当作信号处理对象的工作是一条线。第三，它参数开销很小，若在长上下文下确实能稳定提升，可能对 attention 稀疏化、token pruning、KV 预算分配有启发。局限也很明显：实验规模小，提升幅度不大，长上下文收益目前还是推测，理论叙述里有不少类比成分，离“可作为通用训练配方”还有距离。
summary.technical_approach: 方法很简单：在标准 attention 的 key/value 侧加一个 energy gate，让每个位置 j 在参与被关注时先乘上一个由该位置 embedding 估计出的显著性系数。作者的理论出发点是 Verma & Pilanci 2024 的视角：把每个 embedding 维度沿序列位置展开，可视为长度为 L 的一维因果信号。再借助 Wiener–Khinchin 定理和 Parseval 恒等式，把位置处的“谱能量”与信号统计量联系起来。实际实现并没有真的做昂贵的频域变换，而是用一个线性投影 w^T x_j 作为 spectrally weighted energy estimator，再经过门控函数得到 g_j。这个 gate 被解释为学习 embedding 谱能量分布的主方向，强投影的位置被视为“coherent structures”，弱投影的位置被视为背景噪声。论文还讨论了固定 wavelet family 与参数化 wavelet family 的替代实现，但结论是固定结构基底不够好，学习式 wavelet packet 可能更合适，不过这部分更像开放问题而不是成熟方案。就架构关系看，EGA 不是替换 softmax attention，也不是改 QK 打分，而是在 attention logits 或 value aggregation 之外增加一个 token-wise multiplicative bias，属于低侵入式改造。和常见的 attention bias、head gating、token pruning 不同，它的 gating 信号不依赖当前 query，而是试图编码 token 的内在信息密度。
summary.experiments: 实验结论可以概括为“有小幅、稳定但有限的收益”。作者报告在两个数据集、两个独立初始化下，验证损失平均改善约 0.103，额外参数开销低于 0.26%。从论文给出的叙述看，收益主要体现在 validation loss，而不是大规模下游 benchmark 的系统提升。一个有意思的观察是门控阈值或稀疏比例相关参数 τ 稳定在约 0.35，作者把它解释为英语连续文本中 content words 的占比，这个现象在两次不同初始化下都出现，说明 gate 学到的不是完全任意的稀疏模式。消融部分比较了固定与参数化 wavelet 方案，结果支持“固定基底不足以刻画语言 token 的显著性结构”。但需要注意，论文没有给出大模型规模、长上下文、不同语种、不同 tokenizer 条件下的系统验证，也没有证明这种 gate 在训练稳定性、收敛速度或推理效率上带来明确收益。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先抓三件事。第一，看 Introduction 里作者如何把 relevance 和 salience 分开，这决定了方法是否值得继续追。第二，看 Method 中 gate 的具体插入位置和参数化形式，不要被流体力学和神经科学类比带偏，真正重要的是它最终只是一个怎样的 token-wise bias。第三，看 ablation，尤其是固定 wavelet 与可学习方案的比较，以及 τ≈0.35 的稳定性现象。如果时间有限，优先看方法公式、主结果表和消融图，20 到 30 分钟足够建立判断。深挖时要重点问两个问题：一是这个线性投影到底学到了“谱能量”，还是只是学到了某种常规 token importance score；二是它与已有的 attention sink、token salience、importance reweighting 方法相比，新增信息到底在哪里。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific gap in standard attention: query-key similarity tells the model which tokens are relevant to the current query, but not which tokens are intrinsically informative on their own. The proposed framing is token-level salience estimation. The authors argue that some positions carry higher spectral energy in the embedding signal and should therefore receive more attention than low-information background tokens. For language modeling, this means treating syntactic heads, discourse markers, or morphological boundaries differently from filler tokens and repeated patterns. This is not a new pretraining pipeline; it is an architectural bias added to Transformer attention.
summary_en.importance: Its impact on foundation-model pretraining is moderate and mostly conceptual at this stage. The main contribution is a clean decomposition of attention into query-conditioned relevance and query-independent salience. That is useful because many attention variants implicitly mix the two. A second contribution is methodological: it extends the recent signal-processing view of LLM representations by using spectral energy as a token salience proxy. A third practical point is that the module is lightweight, so if the effect survives at scale, it could inform token pruning, KV budget allocation, or long-context attention design. The limitations are equally clear: experiments are small, gains are modest, and the long-context benefit is still a hypothesis rather than an established result.
summary_en.technical_approach: Energy-Gated Attention adds a token-wise gate on the key/value side of standard attention. Before a position j contributes to attention, it is reweighted by a scalar gate g_j derived from that token’s embedding. The theoretical motivation comes from viewing each embedding dimension across sequence positions as a 1D causal signal, following Verma and Pilanci. Using the Wiener–Khinchin theorem and Parseval’s identity, the paper motivates spectral energy as a measure of token salience. In practice, however, the implementation is much simpler than the theory might suggest: a learned linear projection w^T x_j serves as a spectrally weighted energy estimator, and a gating function converts it into a multiplicative salience factor. The learned direction is interpreted as the dominant mode of spectral variance in the corpus. Tokens with strong projection onto that direction are treated as coherent structures; weakly projecting tokens are treated as background. The paper also explores wavelet-based variants and concludes that fixed wavelet families are too rigid, while learned wavelet packets may be a better direction. Relative to standard attention modifications, EGA is low-intrusion: it does not replace softmax attention and does not alter the QK similarity itself. Its distinctive feature is that the gating signal is query-independent and intended to encode intrinsic token information density.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical picture is: small but consistent gains. The paper reports an average validation-loss improvement of about 0.103 with less than 0.26% parameter overhead, replicated across two datasets and two independent initializations. The evidence is centered on validation loss rather than broad downstream evaluation. One notable observation is that the learned threshold or sparsity-related parameter tau stabilizes around 0.35, which the authors interpret as roughly matching the fraction of content words in English running text. That pattern appears across different initializations, suggesting the gate is not learning an arbitrary mask. The ablation study compares fixed and parametric wavelet families and supports the claim that fixed structured bases are suboptimal for this setting. Still, the paper does not establish behavior at large model scale, under long contexts, across languages, or across tokenizer choices. It also does not show clear gains in optimization stability, convergence speed, or inference efficiency.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, focus on three parts. First, read the motivation that separates relevance from salience; that is the real conceptual claim. Second, inspect the exact insertion point and parameterization of the gate in the method section. The fluid-dynamics and neuroscience analogies are secondary; what matters is the final computational object. Third, read the ablations, especially the comparison between fixed wavelets and learnable variants, and the stability of tau around 0.35. If time is limited, the method equations, main result table, and ablation figures are enough for a 20–30 minute pass. If you want to go deeper, ask two questions: does the linear projection genuinely capture spectral energy, or is it simply learning a generic token-importance score; and compared with prior token salience or importance reweighting methods, what new signal is actually being introduced here?

recommendation.zh: 用谱能量做注意力门控的思路新颖，可在小模型 ablation 中快速验证效果，只读方法部分即可
recommendation.en: The spectral energy attention gating idea is novel, can be quickly verified in small model ablations, only read the method section

paper.title: Causal Evidence for Attention Head Imbalance in Modality Conflict Hallucination
paper.abstract: Modality-conflict hallucination occurs when multimodal large language models (MLLMs) prioritize erroneous textual premises over contradictory visual evidence. To understand why visual evidence fails to prevail during generation, we take a mechanistic perspective and examine which internal components drive or resist this failure. We perform head-level causal analysis using path patching across five open-source MLLMs and identify two groups of attention heads with opposing causal roles: hallucinat

summary.core_problem: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在面对文本预设与视觉证据冲突时，为何常产生偏向错误文本的幻觉？
summary.importance: 从机制可解释性（Mechanistic Interpretability）角度，首次在注意力头（Attention Head）级别揭示了多模态冲突幻觉的因果机制，为理解和缓解此类幻觉提供了内部视角。
summary.technical_approach: 采用路径修补（Path Patching）技术，在五个开源 MLLMs 上进行头级别的因果分析。通过对比冲突输入（包含错误文本预设）和干净输入（无偏预设）下的激活差异，识别出两类作用相反的注意力头：驱动幻觉的头（Hallucination-driving heads）和抵抗幻觉的头（Hallucination-resisting heads）。基于此发现，提出了一种概念验证性的推理时干预方法 MACI，利用抵抗头的激活来检测冲突，并在必要时抑制驱动头。
summary.experiments: 在五个 7B-8B 模型上发现一致的不对称性：驱动幻觉的效应分布更广、总权重更大，而抵抗效应集中在少数高重要性的头上。消融实验证实了这些头的因果作用。MACI 在 MMMC 数据集上显著降低了幻觉，并在 SCI-SemanticConflict 上表现出零样本迁移能力。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读第 2 节关于因果分析的实验设计和结果，特别是图 2 中驱动头和抵抗头的不对称分布。第 3 节的消融实验和 MACI 方法的评估也值得关注，了解如何利用内部机制进行推理时干预。预计阅读时间 20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Why do Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) often hallucinate by favoring erroneous textual premises over contradictory visual evidence?
summary_en.importance: Provides the first causal evidence at the attention-head level for modality-conflict hallucination from a mechanistic interpretability perspective, offering internal insights for understanding and mitigating such hallucinations.
summary_en.technical_approach: Applies path patching, a mechanistic interpretability technique, to perform head-level causal analysis across five open-source MLLMs. By comparing activations under conflict inputs (with erroneous textual premises) and clean inputs (unbiased premises), it identifies two groups of attention heads with opposing causal roles: hallucination-driving heads and hallucination-resisting heads. Based on this, a proof-of-concept inference-time intervention, MACI, is proposed, which uses resisting-head activations to detect conflict and suppresses driving heads when necessary.
summary_en.experiments: Reveals a consistent asymmetry across five 7B-8B models: driving effects are more broadly distributed and carry greater aggregate weight, whereas resisting effects concentrate in a small number of high-importance heads. Ablation experiments confirm the causal roles of these heads. MACI significantly reduces hallucinations on the MMMC dataset and demonstrates zero-shot transfer to SCI-SemanticConflict.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 for the experimental design and results of the causal analysis, especially Figure 2 showing the asymmetric distribution of driving and resisting heads. Section 3 on ablation experiments and the evaluation of MACI is also worth reading to understand how internal mechanisms can be leveraged for inference-time intervention. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 用path patching做的因果机制分析，发现了驱动幻觉和抵抗幻觉的两类注意力头的不平衡结构。对理解MLLM幻觉机制有参考价值，重点看Fig 2和消融实验部分
recommendation.en: Causal mechanism analysis using path patching reveals imbalanced structure between hallucination-driving and resisting heads. Useful for understanding MLLM hallucination; focus on Fig 2 and ablation sections.

paper.title: The Routing and Filtering Structure of Attention
paper.abstract: The attention interaction matrix $QK^{\top}$ contains two entangled computations: a skew-symmetric component that redistributes information between positions (routing) and a symmetric component that scales mutual relevance (filtering). We decompose 1776 heads across five pretrained transformers and find routing operating at low rank, well below the routing capacity allocated by the weight kernel. We introduce $S$-$D$ attention as a diagnostic parameterization that disentangles routing from filte

summary.core_problem: 标准Transformer的注意力交互矩阵QK^T纠缠了两种独立计算：负责位置间信息定向转移的路由（斜对称分量）和负责评估互相关度的滤波（对称分量），二者资源需求不同但无法被区分，导致没有可测量的原则指导注意力层的资源分配，现有混合架构（如Jamba、Nemotron-H）的层间结构只能通过网格搜索确定，无法泛化到不同参数规模。
summary.importance: 为预训练架构设计提供了直接的方法学启发：首次明确拆分注意力的两个核心功能，证明路由分量天然是低秩的，为低秩/线性注意力替代方案的层间选择提供了可量化的依据，不需要盲目搜索层间混合比例。
summary.technical_approach: 首先对任意注意力头的QK^T做唯一的对称-斜对称分解，分离出滤波（对称分量，无向相似度）和路由（斜对称分量，定向信息转移）两个分量。随后提出S-D注意力作为诊断参数化方式，将无约束的QK^T替换为L=S-D，其中S是可学习的斜对称矩阵，D是可学习的正对角矩阵，该构造保证所有特征值的实部≤0，不需要层归一化就能稳定训练。
summary.experiments: 对5个预训练Transformer的共1776个注意力头做分解，发现路由在真实文本上的实际秩远低于权重核分配的容量，且滤波分量占主导。训练355M参数的S-D注意力模型，不需要任何归一化就能稳定训练；路由会自发形成谱级联：第一层秩为2，随深度逐渐升高，该模式在7M到355M参数规模下均存在；滤波分量则随深度从高秩收敛到每个头一个标量。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注路由-滤波分解的数学原理、对预训练注意力头的统计分析结果，以及S-D注意力的自组织谱级联现象，预计阅读时间20分钟；核心是理解注意力两个内在功能的分离，及其秩随深度的变化规律，不需要深入理论证明细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The standard Transformer attention interaction matrix QK^T entangles two distinct computations: routing (skew-symmetric component) that directionally transfers information between positions, and filtering (symmetric component) that evaluates pairwise mutual relevance. The two functions have different resource requirements but cannot be separated, leaving no measurable principle to guide resource allocation across attention layers. Existing hybrid architectures such as Jamba and Nemotron-H rely on grid search to determine layer structures, which does not generalize across parameter scales.
summary_en.importance: It provides direct methodological insights for pretraining architecture design: it explicitly separates the two core functions of attention for the first time, and proves that the routing component is inherently low-rank. This offers a quantifiable basis for selecting layers to replace with low-rank or linear attention mechanisms, eliminating the need for blind search of inter-layer mixing ratios.
summary_en.technical_approach: First, it decomposes any attention head's QK^T into a unique symmetric-skew symmetric pair, separating filtering (symmetric component, undirected similarity) and routing (skew-symmetric component, directional information transfer). Then it proposes S-D attention as a diagnostic parameterization, replacing the unconstrained QK^T with L = S - D, where S is a learnable skew-symmetric matrix and D is a learnable positive diagonal matrix. This construction guarantees Re(λ) ≤ 0 for all eigenvalues, enabling stable training without layer normalization.
summary_en.experiments: Decomposition of 1,776 attention heads across 5 pretrained Transformers shows that the effective rank of routing on real text is far lower than the capacity allocated by the weight kernel, and filtering dominates the interaction matrix. A 355M parameter S-D attention model trains stably without any normalization. Routing self-organizes into a spectral cascade: rank starts at 2 in the first layer and increases with depth, a pattern consistent across scales from 7M to 355M parameters. Filtering converges in the opposite direction, from high-rank relevance landscapes to a single scalar per head.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the mathematical principle of routing-filtering decomposition, statistical analysis of pretrained attention heads, and the self-organized spectral cascade phenomenon of S-D attention. Expected reading time is 20 minutes. The core takeaway is the separation of two intrinsic attention functions and their rank evolution across depth, no need to dig into detailed theoretical proofs.

recommendation.zh: 注意力解耦的基础分析工作，S-D注意力的谱级联发现很扎实，重点看§3的分解方法和Fig4的低秩实验结果。
recommendation.en: Solid fundamental analysis of attention disentanglement; the spectral cascade finding of S-D attention is well-supported, focus on §3 decomposition method and Fig.4 low-rank experiments.

paper.title: GQLA: Group-Query Latent Attention for Hardware-Adaptive Large Language Model Decoding
paper.abstract: Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA), the attention used in DeepSeek-V2/V3, jointly compresses keys and values into a low-rank latent and matches the H100 roofline almost perfectly. Its trained weights, however, expose only one decoding path - an absorbed MQA form - which ties efficient inference to H100-class compute-bandwidth ratios, forfeits tensor parallelism along the head axis, and yields no Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) gain on commodity inference GPUs such as the export-restricted H20. summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 DeepSeek-V2/V3 所用 MLA 在推理部署上的一个结构性限制：它虽然把 KV cache 压得很低，但训练好的权重在解码时基本只暴露出一种高效路径，也就是 absorbed MQA 形式。这条路径在 H100 这类高算力高算带比硬件上很合适，但一旦换到 H20 这类带宽还在、算力明显下降的卡上，就会从 memory-bound 变成 compute-bound，吞吐掉得很厉害；同时它还不利于沿 head 维做 tensor parallel，也让 multi-token prediction 几乎拿不到收益。论文要解决的核心问题不是再发明一种更省 KV 的注意力，而是让同一套训练权重能根据硬件特性切换不同的等价解码路径，从而把 MLA 从“只适配一种 roofline 的设计”改成“可按硬件自适应部署的设计”。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏推理架构与系统效率，不属于 llm_pretrain 主线，但对做基座模型架构的人仍有参考价值，因为它讨论的是注意力参数化方式如何约束后续部署自由度。它的重要性主要有三层。第一，它指出 MLA 的优势并不是无条件成立，而是和 H100 的 compute/bandwidth 比较强耦合，这个判断很有现实意义。第二，它把“训练时参数等价、部署时路径可切换”明确成一个设计目标，这对以后做硬件感知架构搜索、attention parameterization、甚至 unified train-serve co-design 都有启发。第三，它给出了一条从已有 GQA checkpoint 迁移到 GQLA 的低成本路径 TransGQLA，说明这种结构改动不一定要从头预训练。量级上看，这更像一篇针对 MLA 部署局限的定向修正，而不是新的基础建模范式；启发主要在架构可部署性，而不是语言建模能力本身。
summary.technical_approach:
GQLA 的核心思想是保留 MLA 的 latent KV 压缩框架，但把上投影的索引方式从“按 query head 复制”改成“按 group 建模”，从而让同一组参数支持两条代数等价的解码路径。

先看 MLA 的问题。MLA 训练和 prefill 时可以像 MHA 一样把 latent 展开成 per-head K/V 来算 attention；但在 decoding 时，为了省 cache 和带宽，会把上投影吸收到 query/output projection 里，直接对 latent 做 attention，也就是 absorbed MQA path。这个路径的 arithmetic intensity 在 H100 上接近 roofline，很合适；但它只有这一条路。因为所有 query head 都共享同一个 latent KV，head 维 tensor parallel 很难做零冗余切分；而且一旦做 MTP，额外 query token 会继续抬高算强度，在 H20 这类低 ridge point 设备上几乎没有吞吐收益。

GQLA 的改法很克制。输入 token 先经 W^DKV 压到低秩 latent c_t^{KV}，这一点和 MLA 一样；不同之处在于 W^UK 和 W^UV 不再为每个 query head 单独展开，而是只展开成 g 个 KV groups。这样训练后权重可以有两种解码解释：
1) MQA-absorb path：和 MLA 一样，cache 里存 latent c^{KV} 加共享 RoPE key，所有 query head 直接对 latent 注意力，适合 H100 这类高算力卡；
2) GQA path：把 latent 物化成 per-group 的 K_C, V，并缓存这些 group 级 K/V，再用标准 GQA kernel 解码，适合 H20 这类更容易 compute-bound 的卡。

关键点在于这两条路径对同一组训练参数是代数等价的，不需要重新训练不同模型。论文推荐配置是 h_q=128, g=8，再配一个 MTP head。这个配置下，H100 上单 token decoding 走 MQA-absorb，继续吃到 MLA 的低 cache 优势；H20 上则走 GQA path，并借助更低的 arithmetic intensity 把运行点拉回硬件 ridge 附近，同时支持最多 8 路沿 group 维的零冗余 tensor parallel。

论文还提出 TransGQLA，用于把已有 pretrained GQA checkpoint 转成 GQLA。它是在 TransMLA 的转换流程上做一个很小的修改：head merging 时保留 group 索引，而不是合并到 query-head 级别。作者强调这基本是 one-line change，目的是避免从头预训练。另一个扩展是 sparse attention：由于 GQLA 在 GQA path 下的 query-per-KV-head 比 h_q/g=16，正好匹配 Tensor Core MMA tile，因此稀疏版本在 H20 类硬件上仍能保留 GQA 路径；而 sparse MLA 仍被锁在 sparse MQA-absorb 路径上。

方法上的核心贡献不是新的 attention score 公式，而是参数布局和缓存布局的重新设计，让“同权重多执行路径”成为可能。
summary.experiments:
实验由两部分组成：roofline 分析和实证验证。roofline 部分是全文论证的基础。作者给出 MLA canonical 配置在 H100 上单 token decoding 的 arithmetic intensity 约为 242 FLOPs/byte，接近 H100 BF16 ridge point 约 295，因此 MLA 在 H100 上几乎是理想匹配；但 H20 的 ridge 只有约 37 FLOPs/byte，MLA 远高于这个点，因而会变成 compute-bound。GQLA 的目标就是让同一权重在不同硬件上落到不同但都合理的 operating point。

论文声称在推荐配置 h_q=128, g=8 并带一个 MTP head 时，H100 + MQA-absorb path 可以继承 MLA 的甜点区，而 H20 + GQA path + s_q=2 的 multi-token prediction 能接近理想吞吐增益。这里最关键的实验信息不是单个 benchmark 分数，而是吞吐、算带匹配和 TP 可扩展性。正文片段提到在 LLaMA-3-8B 上验证了 TransGQLA，但没有给出完整表格数字，因此无法在这里复述具体 perplexity 或 throughput 数值。

从已给内容能确认的实验结论有三点。第一，GQLA 两条路径在数学上等价，因而不会因为切换路径而引入额外精度损失。第二，在 H100 类设备上，它不会牺牲 MLA 的优势，因为仍可走原来的 absorbed path。第三，在 H20 类设备上，它通过切到 GQA path 降低算强度，并让 MTP 真正带来吞吐提升，而不是像 MLA 那样继续被 compute 限制。

如果看消融重点，最值得关注的是 group 数 g、query head 数 h_q、MTP token 数 s_q 对 arithmetic intensity 和 cache footprint 的共同影响，以及 TransGQLA 转换后与原始 GQA/MLA 在质量和速度上的差距。论文的价值主要建立在这些 trade-off 是否被量化清楚。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时建议按“问题设定—公式等价—roofline—实证”四步读。

先看 Introduction，把作者对 MLA 三个缺点的界定看清楚：hardware coupling、TP-unfriendly、MTP-unfriendly。这里不是泛泛谈效率，而是在特定 roofline 模型下指出 MLA 为什么只适合一类 GPU。

然后看 Methods 里 GQLA 的参数化方式，尤其是 latent 到 K/V 的上投影为什么按 group 而不是按 head，以及两条解码路径为什么代数等价。这里是全文最核心的技术点。如果这部分没看懂，后面的硬件分析会显得像经验调参。

第三步重点看 Section 4 的 roofline analysis。作者的主要说服力来自 arithmetic intensity 的推导，而不是语言建模指标。要特别留意 H100 与 H20 的 ridge point、不同路径的 FLOPs/byte、以及 MTP 为什么会把 MLA 进一步推向 compute-bound。

最后看 LLaMA-3-8B 上的验证实验，重点不是绝对分数，而是路径切换是否保持质量、吞吐是否符合 roofline 预测、TP 是否真的做到零冗余。若只做泛读，30 分钟左右足够；若要判断这套设计是否值得用于新模型架构，建议把公式推导和硬件假设都过一遍。

summary_en.core_problem: GQLA addresses a structural deployment limitation of Multi-head Latent Attention as used in DeepSeek-V2/V3. MLA achieves very strong KV-cache compression, but at decode time its trained weights effectively expose only one efficient execution path: the absorbed MQA form. That path is well matched to H100-class hardware, where compute-to-bandwidth ratios are high, but it becomes poorly matched on lower-compute GPUs such as H20, where the same arithmetic intensity pushes decoding into a compute-bound regime. The same design also makes head-axis tensor parallelism awkward and leaves little or no throughput gain from multi-token prediction. The paper’s central problem is therefore not how to compress KV further, but how to parameterize latent attention so that one trained model can expose multiple algebraically equivalent decoding paths and choose the one that best matches the target hardware.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference-architecture paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it is still relevant to foundation-model researchers because it shows how attention parameterization can lock in or preserve deployment flexibility. Its importance is threefold. First, it makes explicit that MLA’s efficiency is hardware-conditional rather than universal; the design is tightly coupled to H100-like rooflines. Second, it elevates a useful design principle: keep training-time parameters fixed while exposing multiple deployment-time execution paths. That idea is relevant to train-serve co-design more broadly. Third, the proposed TransGQLA conversion suggests that this flexibility can be added to existing checkpoints without full pretraining. The contribution is best read as a targeted architectural correction to MLA’s deployment constraints, not as a new language-modeling paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core idea of GQLA is to retain MLA’s latent KV compression while changing how the latent up-projections are indexed. Instead of effectively replicating them across all query heads, GQLA indexes them by groups. This small change allows the same trained parameters to support two algebraically equivalent decoding paths.

To understand the motivation, recall MLA’s behavior. During training and prefill, the latent can be expanded into per-head keys and values and attention is computed in an MHA-like form. During decoding, however, the up-projections are absorbed into the query and output projections so that attention runs directly against the latent, yielding an absorbed MQA-style path. This is excellent for H100 because the arithmetic intensity lands near the hardware roofline. But it is the only path MLA exposes. Since all query heads share one latent KV representation, tensor parallelism along the head axis becomes replication-heavy, and adding MTP further increases arithmetic intensity, which is especially harmful on H20-class devices.

GQLA keeps the same low-rank latent compression step via W^DKV, but changes W^UK and W^UV so that the latent expands into g KV groups rather than per-query-head representations. As a result, the trained weights admit two decode-time interpretations:
1) an MQA-absorb path, identical in spirit to MLA, where the cache stores the latent c^{KV} plus the shared RoPE key and all query heads attend directly to the latent; and
2) a GQA path, where the latent is materialized into per-group K and V tensors and decoding uses a standard GQA kernel.

The key point is that these two paths are algebraically equivalent over the same parameters. No retraining is needed to switch execution mode. The recommended configuration is h_q = 128 and g = 8, plus one MTP head. Under this setup, H100 can continue using the absorbed path and preserve MLA’s cache-efficiency sweet spot, while H20 can switch to the GQA path, lower effective arithmetic intensity, and recover throughput gains from MTP. The GQA path also enables up to 8-way zero-redundancy tensor parallelism along the group axis.

The paper also proposes TransGQLA, a lightweight conversion from a pretrained GQA checkpoint to GQLA. It is described as a minimal modification to the TransMLA pipeline: during head merging, preserve group indexing instead of collapsing everything to query-head indexing. A sparse-attention extension is also discussed. Because GQLA’s GQA path yields a query-per-KV-head ratio of h_q / g = 16, it aligns well with Tensor Core MMA tiling, allowing sparse GQLA to preserve the GQA path on H20-like hardware, unlike sparse MLA which remains locked to sparse absorbed-MQA execution.

The main contribution is therefore not a new attention score formulation, but a parameter and cache layout that preserves multiple hardware-adaptive execution paths for the same model weights.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation has two pillars: roofline analysis and empirical validation. The roofline argument is central. For canonical MLA settings, the paper estimates single-token decoding arithmetic intensity at about 242 FLOPs/byte, close to the H100 BF16 ridge point of roughly 295 FLOPs/byte. That explains why MLA is such a good fit on H100. But H20’s ridge point is only around 37 FLOPs/byte, so the same MLA decode path becomes strongly compute-bound there. GQLA is designed so that the same weights can land on different, more appropriate operating points depending on the hardware.

The paper claims that with the recommended h_q = 128, g = 8 configuration and one MTP head, H100 plus the MQA-absorb path preserves MLA’s favorable operating point, while H20 plus the GQA path at s_q = 2 can approach the hardware ridge and recover near-ideal throughput gains from MTP. The most important outcomes are therefore throughput, arithmetic-intensity matching, and tensor-parallel scalability rather than language-model benchmark gains. The provided text mentions validation on LLaMA-3-8B via TransGQLA, but does not include the full numerical tables, so exact perplexity or throughput numbers cannot be reproduced here.

Still, three conclusions are clear from the available content. First, the two GQLA paths are mathematically equivalent, so path switching should not introduce accuracy drift by itself. Second, on H100-class devices, GQLA does not give up MLA’s main advantage because it can still use the absorbed path. Third, on H20-class devices, switching to the GQA path lowers the effective compute pressure and allows MTP to produce real throughput gains instead of being nullified by compute bottlenecks.

For ablations, the most informative ones are likely the interactions among group count g, query-head count h_q, and MTP token count s_q, since these jointly determine cache footprint and arithmetic intensity. The paper’s practical value depends on whether those trade-offs are quantified cleanly against baseline GQA and MLA variants.
summary_en.reading_guide:
A good skim order is: problem framing, equivalence construction, roofline analysis, then empirical validation.

Start with the introduction and make sure the three claimed MLA drawbacks are clear: hardware coupling, poor tensor-parallel behavior, and no MTP gain on lower-compute GPUs. The paper is not making a generic efficiency claim; it is making a hardware-specific argument grounded in roofline behavior.

Then read the method section carefully enough to understand why indexing the latent up-projections by group rather than by head creates two algebraically equivalent decode paths. That is the technical center of the paper. Without that, the hardware discussion can look like tuning rather than architecture.

Next, spend time on the roofline analysis. The paper’s main persuasive force comes from arithmetic-intensity calculations, not from language-model quality numbers. Pay attention to the ridge points for H100 and H20, the FLOPs/byte of each path, and why MTP pushes MLA further into the compute-bound regime.

Finally, read the LLaMA-3-8B validation with a focus on whether path switching preserves model quality, whether throughput follows the roofline predictions, and whether tensor parallelism is truly zero-redundancy along the group axis. A 30-minute skim is enough to capture the main idea, but a serious evaluation requires checking the derivations and hardware assumptions in detail.

recommendation.zh: 对DeepSeek MLA的一次实用且低成本的增强——双路径设计巧妙，同一套权重适配不同硬件，对多平台部署有直接参考价值。值得读方法部分理解代数等价性证明。
recommendation.en: A practical and low-cost enhancement to DeepSeek's MLA—the dual-path design is clever, enabling weight reuse across hardware. Worth reading the method section for the algebraic equivalence proof.

paper.title: Stateful Reasoning via Insight Replay
paper.abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning has become a foundation for eliciting multi-step reasoning in large language models, but recent studies show that its benefits do not scale monotonically with chain length: while longer CoT generally enables a model to tackle harder problems, on a given problem, accuracy typically increases with CoT length up to a point, after which it declines. summary.core_problem: 为什么长思维链(CoT)在达到一定长度后，模型在特定问题上的准确率反而会下降？
summary.importance: 揭示了长CoT性能下降的机制（注意力衰减导致早期关键洞察丢失），并提出了一种状态化推理方法InsightReplay来缓解该问题，对理解和改进长上下文推理有重要意义。
summary.technical_approach: 1) 机制分析：发现随着CoT变长，模型对早期生成的关键洞察的注意力逐渐减弱。2) 提出InsightReplay：一种状态化推理方法，模型定期从推理轨迹中提取关键洞察，并在当前生成边界附近重放，使其在推理扩展时保持可访问。
summary.experiments: 在2x3x4的基准网格上进行了广泛实验（涵盖不同模型规模等），具体提升幅度和Baseline未在摘要中详述。
summary.authors_note: 明尼苏达大学和Simular AI合作。

summary_en.core_problem: Why does the accuracy of models on specific problems decline after Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reaches a certain length?
summary_en.importance: Reveals the mechanism behind the performance drop in long CoT (attention decay leading to loss of early critical insights) and proposes a stateful reasoning approach, InsightReplay, to mitigate it, significant for understanding and improving long-context reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Mechanism analysis: Discovers that as CoT grows, the model's attention to early-generated critical insights gradually weakens. 2) Proposes InsightReplay: A stateful reasoning approach where the model periodically extracts critical insights from its reasoning trace and replays them near the active generation frontier, keeping them accessible as reasoning scales.
summary_en.experiments: Extensive experiments on a 2x3x4 benchmark grid (covering different model scales, etc.). Specific improvement margins and baselines are not detailed in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Collaboration between University of Minnesota and Simular AI.

recommendation.zh: 诊断了长CoT性能衰减的'注意力遗忘'机制，并用显式重放(InsightReplay)来打补丁，对理解长上下文推理的注意力动态和设计更鲁棒的CoT策略很有启发。
recommendation.en: Diagnoses the 'attention forgetting' mechanism of long CoT performance decay and patches it with explicit replay (InsightReplay), highly inspiring for understanding attention dynamics in long-context reasoning and designing more robust CoT strategies.

paper.title: ASAP: Amortized Doubly-Stochastic Attention via Sliced Dual Projection
paper.abstract: Doubly-stochastic attention has emerged as a transport-based alternative to row-softmax attention, with recent Transformer variants using it to reduce attention sinks and rank collapse while improving performance. In this family, the standard approach is Sinkhorn scaling, which trains more efficiently but still repeats matrix scaling in every inference forward pass. Sliced-transport attention removes the online iteration, but its soft sorting approximation materializes dense tensors for each sli

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 doubly-stochastic attention 的一个工程与方法折中问题：Sinkhorn attention 训练相对便宜，也能带来列约束带来的好处，但推理时每次前向都要做多步矩阵缩放；而 sliced-transport 一类非迭代方案推理更轻，却在训练时需要更重的 soft sorting 近似，资源代价高。作者要解决的核心问题，是能否保留 Sinkhorn 训练阶段的低成本与效果，同时在推理阶段把迭代归一化“编译掉”，得到接近 teacher Sinkhorn operator 的非迭代近似。
summary.importance: 它和 LLM 预训练的关系主要在注意力归一化设计与训练/推理接口，而不是传统 serving 小修小补。若 doubly-stochastic attention 确实能缓解 attention sinks、rank collapse 等问题，那么它的落地障碍之一就是 inference overhead。ASAP 的贡献在于提出一种 train-then-compile 路线：训练时仍用成熟的 Sinkhorn，训练后再学习一个轻量映射去近似在线求解的 dual variables。这个思路对预训练研究有两点启发。第一，某些训练时昂贵但结构良好的算子，不一定要在推理时原样保留，可以把“求解器”蒸馏成参数化近似。第二，attention 归一化不必只在 softmax 与硬替代之间二选一，还可以把最优传输里的 dual structure 单独拿出来做编译。贡献量级更像 attention layer 设计上的实用推进，是否会影响大规模 LLM 还要看长序列、因果掩码和大模型训练稳定性上的进一步验证。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是把训练好的 Sinkhorn attention 看成 teacher，然后学习一个近似其 query-side dual 的编译器。具体流程分几步。第一步，正常训练带有限步 Sinkhorn scaling 的 doubly-stochastic attention 层。这里 teacher 的定义不是无限步最优传输，而是固定预算 S 的有限 Sinkhorn 归一化，因此学生要逼近的是实际部署会用到的有限步算子，而不是理想极限。第二步，冻结 teacher，用一个小的无标签 calibration set 跑前向，抽取每次 Sinkhorn 循环最终得到的 query-side normalization vector，也就是 source dual。第三步，在同一组 query/key 激活上，沿若干投影方向做一维排序，计算精确的一维 transport potentials，把这些 sliced geometric features 作为输入特征。第四步，训练一个轻量参数映射，从 sliced dual features 回归 teacher 的 source dual。作者给出多种校准方式，包括 least-squares 和 convex-KL。第五步，推理时不再运行完整 Sinkhorn loop，而是先预测 source dual，再通过 entropic c-transform 解析恢复 key-side dual，从而构造两侧归一化后的 attention operator。文中还区分 one-sided 与 two-sided c-transform 变体。和 ESPFormer 这类 sliced-transport attention 的区别在于，ASAP 不改变训练时的 attention 构造，也不依赖训练期 soft sorting relaxation；它是后处理式编译，目标是贴近一个已训练好的 Sinkhorn teacher。和直接减少 Sinkhorn 迭代步数相比，ASAP 不是简单用更粗糙的归一化替代，而是试图学习 teacher 在给定激活分布下会收敛到什么 dual 变量，因此更像 operator approximation。
summary.experiments: 论文给出的关键对比集中在训练资源与推理速度。作者在 IMDb 的 matched-resource 配置下报告：ESPFormer 所用 SoftSort 训练算子，相比 S=10 的 Sinkhorn teacher，峰值训练显存高 5.7 倍，单样本训练速度慢 14.8 倍。这是提出 ASAP 的直接动机。ASAP 自身的实验覆盖语言和视觉 benchmark，目标是比较三类对象：原始迭代 Sinkhorn teacher、sliced-transport baseline、以及编译后的 ASAP。摘要与正文前段强调的是“显著的 layer speedup”，同时尽量保持接近 teacher 的性能与 doubly-stochastic 结构。由于给到的全文片段没有完整结果表，无法可靠抄出所有任务上的最终精度数字，但从作者描述看，重点不是超过 teacher，而是在不重训主模型的前提下，用小规模 calibration 学到一个推理更快、效果接近的替代层。阅读时应特别关注：1）不同校准目标（LS vs convex-KL）对 operator fidelity 的影响；2）one-sided 与 two-sided c-transform 的精度/速度取舍；3）编译后误差是否随序列长度、层深、模态变化而放大；4）与直接减少 Sinkhorn 步数相比，ASAP 的优势是否稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议先看 Introduction，作者把问题讲得比较清楚：Sinkhorn 训练便宜但推理慢，sliced transport 推理快但训练重。然后看 Background 里 doubly-stochastic attention 与 Sinkhorn 的定义，确认 dual variables 在层里扮演什么角色。接着重点看方法部分，尤其是 calibration pipeline、sliced dual features 的构造、以及 c-transform 如何恢复另一侧 dual。实验部分优先看资源对比表和主结果表，再看 ablation：投影数、校准集大小、回归目标、one-sided/two-sided 选择。预计 35-50 分钟能抓住主线。若你关心 LLM 预训练，可重点思考两个问题：这种编译式近似在 causal mask 下是否仍成立；以及它是否能与长上下文注意力优化结合，而不是只在中短序列分类或视觉任务上成立。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical trilemma in doubly-stochastic attention. Sinkhorn-based attention is relatively cheap to train and brings the benefits of column-balanced normalization, but it still requires iterative matrix scaling at every inference call. Sliced-transport alternatives remove online iteration, yet their training-time soft sorting relaxations are much more expensive. The core question is whether one can keep the cheaper Sinkhorn training setup and then compile away most of the iterative normalization at inference, while staying close to the trained Sinkhorn operator.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining is through attention design and the train-inference interface, not generic serving optimization. If doubly-stochastic attention is indeed useful for reducing attention sinks and rank collapse, then inference cost is one of the main barriers to broader adoption. ASAP contributes a train-then-compile recipe: train with a standard finite-step Sinkhorn layer, then learn a lightweight parametric map that predicts the dual variables the Sinkhorn loop would otherwise solve for online. Two ideas matter here. First, some structured but expensive inference-time solvers may be replaceable by learned surrogates without changing the training recipe. Second, transport-based attention can be decomposed into a teacher operator plus a compiled dual predictor, rather than treated as a monolithic alternative to softmax. The contribution is best read as a practical step in attention-layer design; whether it matters for large causal LMs still depends on evidence at longer context, larger scale, and under autoregressive masking.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method treats a trained Sinkhorn attention layer as a frozen teacher and learns to approximate its query-side dual variables. The pipeline is straightforward. First, train a Transformer with finite-step Sinkhorn normalization in the attention layer. Importantly, the target is not the infinite-step optimal transport solution, but the actual finite-budget operator used in practice. Second, freeze the teacher and run a small unlabeled calibration set through it. From each forward pass, extract the query-side normalization vector produced by the Sinkhorn loop, i.e. the source dual under the finite entropic transport convention. Third, on the same query and key activations, compute exact one-dimensional transport potentials along multiple sorted projection directions. These sliced geometric quantities become features for a lightweight regressor. Fourth, fit a parametric map from the sliced features to the teacher’s source dual, using either least-squares or convex-KL calibration. Fifth, at inference time, predict the source dual directly and recover the key-side dual analytically via an entropic c-transform, yielding a compiled approximation to the original doubly-stochastic operator. The paper also studies one-sided and two-sided c-transform variants. Relative to ESPFormer-style sliced transport, ASAP does not replace the training operator or rely on soft sorting during training; it is a post-training compilation step designed to mimic a trained Sinkhorn teacher. Relative to simply reducing the number of Sinkhorn iterations, it aims to approximate the teacher’s actual fixed-point behavior under the observed activation distribution, which is a more targeted operator approximation.
summary_en.experiments: The most concrete numbers in the visible text concern training cost. Under a matched-resource IMDb setup, the SoftSort-based training operator used in the sliced-transport baseline requires 5.7 times more peak memory and is 14.8 times slower per training example than a Sinkhorn teacher with S = 10 iterations. This cost gap motivates the train-with-Sinkhorn, compile-afterward strategy. The paper evaluates ASAP on both language and vision benchmarks, comparing the original iterative Sinkhorn teacher, sliced-transport baselines, and the compiled ASAP variants. The stated goal is not to beat the teacher, but to obtain significant layer-level speedups while remaining close to the teacher’s performance and preserving the doubly-stochastic structure as much as possible. The provided text does not include the full result tables, so it would be unsafe to invent task-level accuracy numbers. When reading the experiments, the important checks are: how close the compiled layer stays to the teacher under different calibration losses; whether one-sided versus two-sided c-transform changes the speed-accuracy tradeoff; how approximation error scales with sequence length, depth, and modality; and whether ASAP is consistently better than simply using fewer Sinkhorn iterations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction, which frames the trilemma clearly: Sinkhorn is cheaper to train but slower at inference, while sliced transport is faster at inference but expensive to train. Then read the background on doubly-stochastic attention and finite-step Sinkhorn to understand what the dual variables represent. The method section is the main part to focus on, especially the calibration pipeline, the construction of sliced dual features, and the c-transform used to recover the second dual. In the experiments, prioritize the resource comparison table and the main benchmark table, then read the ablations on number of slices, calibration set size, regression objective, and one-sided versus two-sided compilation. Around 35 to 50 minutes should be enough for a solid skim. For pretraining-oriented readers, two follow-up questions are worth keeping in mind: whether the compilation idea survives causal masking, and whether it composes well with long-context attention schemes rather than only moderate-length language or vision settings.

We study Random Soft Prompts (RSPs), which drop the training step entirely and append a freshly drawn sequence of random embedding vectors to the input. summary.core_problem: 论文要分离软提示收益中的两个因素：收益到底来自训练出来的连续向量内容，还是来自把非词表 embedding 注入输入流这个动作本身。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，它把 soft prompt 从“学到了什么内容”重新拉回到“模型对分布外输入 embedding 如何响应”的问题。Random Soft Prompts 不训练、不携带语义，却能在若干数学推理设置中接近优化过的软提示方法，说明连续向量注入会改变早期解码分布，并提供一种训练外的 rollout 多样性来源。这对理解 soft prompt、test-time compute、RL rollout diversity 都有参考意义，但它不是新的预训练目标，也没有证明模型获得了新能力。
summary.technical_approach: 方法很简单：从预训练 embedding 表统计 entry-wise 均值和方差，拟合各向同性 Gaussian，然后在输入中追加一段随机连续向量。每次 rollout 重新采样，向量不对应任何离散 token，也不做梯度优化。作者把它作为软提示方法的对照组，用来检验“注入行为”本身的影响。机制解释分三步：第一，随机 embedding 作为从未见过的位置进入注意力，迫使模型在早期 token 上重新分配注意力；第二，各向同性采样覆盖多个方向，所以不同 rollout 会打开不同隐藏状态分支；第三，随着生成继续，KV cache 中真实生成 token 增多，随机前缀的相对注意力会自然衰减，输出轨迹趋于稳定。它与 Prefix-Tuning、Prompt Tuning、TTSV、SoftCoT、LTPO 的区别在于完全去掉训练阶段，只保留连续向量注入和独立重采样。
summary.experiments: 文中报告了几个关键现象。第一，在 Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B 上，base model 使用不匹配 chat template 会损害推理，而追加 RSP 可恢复最高约 +29 个百分点，说明随机注入不是简单噪声扰动。第二，RSP 在早期解码阶段呈现与 LTPO、TTSV、SoftCoT 类似的 entropy signature，即前几个生成 token 的分布被明显打开。第三，Pass@N 的收益依赖每次 rollout 独立重采样；如果固定同一段随机向量，多样性累积效果会弱很多。第四，RSP 可以和 DAPO 训练组合，说明它提供的是输入侧探索噪声，与基于 rollout 的强化学习训练信号并不冲突。给出的正文片段没有完整表格，因此不宜推断更多模型规模、benchmark 全量数字或显著性细节。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。先看第 3 节机制分析，重点看作者如何把随机 embedding 对注意力输出的影响写成“branch opening”和后续 attenuation。再看第 4 节实验，重点找三类图表：早期 token entropy、Pass@N 随独立重采样的变化、与 DAPO 组合后的结果。读时需要保持一个边界：RSP 更像一种 inference-time stochasticity 和 soft prompt control，不应直接解读为学到隐式 CoT 或新推理能力。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether the gains from soft prompting come from learned continuous prompt content, or from the act of injecting non-vocabulary embeddings into the input stream.
summary_en.importance: The useful signal for pretraining research is about model behavior under out-of-distribution input embeddings. Random Soft Prompts have no learned semantics, yet can match optimized soft prompts in several math-reasoning settings. This suggests that continuous-vector injection can reshape early decoding distributions and create rollout diversity without parameter updates. The result is relevant to soft-prompt analysis, test-time compute, and RL rollout diversity, but it should not be read as evidence that the model has acquired new capabilities.
summary_en.technical_approach: RSP samples a sequence of continuous vectors from an isotropic Gaussian fitted to the entry-wise mean and variance of the pretrained embedding table, then appends those vectors to the input. Each rollout receives a fresh sample. The vectors are not discrete tokens and are never optimized. The paper uses this as a control for learned soft prompts. The proposed mechanism is attention-mediated: the random positions perturb early attention allocation, different Gaussian draws open different hidden-state branches, and the effect fades as generation proceeds because the KV cache becomes dominated by real generated tokens. Compared with Prefix-Tuning, Prompt Tuning, TTSV, SoftCoT, and LTPO, the method removes the training objective and keeps only continuous-vector injection plus independent resampling.
summary_en.experiments: The main reported findings are: on Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B, applying an unsuitable chat template to a base model hurts reasoning, while appending RSP recovers up to about +29 percentage points; RSP shows an early-decoding entropy pattern similar to optimized soft-prompt methods such as LTPO, TTSV, and SoftCoT; Pass@N improves only when RSPs are independently resampled across rollouts, indicating that diversity rather than fixed prompt content drives the gain; and RSP composes with DAPO training, suggesting that input-side stochastic branching can coexist with rollout-diversity optimization. The provided text does not expose the full result tables, so further claims about exact benchmark coverage or statistical strength should be checked in the experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Start with the mechanism section, especially the treatment of attention perturbation, isotropic coverage, and automatic attenuation as the KV cache grows. Then read the experimental plots for early-token entropy, Pass@N under fixed versus resampled RSPs, and the DAPO combination. The main thing to scrutinize is whether the reported accuracy gains come from useful exploration or from benchmark-specific decoding sensitivity.

paper.title: Large Vision-Language Models Get Lost in Attention
paper.abstract: Despite the rapid evolution of training paradigms, the decoder backbone of large vision--language models (LVLMs) remains fundamentally rooted in the residual-connection Transformer architecture. Therefore, deciphering the distinct roles of internal modules is critical for understanding model mechanics and guiding architectural optimization. While prior statistical approaches have provided valuable attribution-based insights, they often lack a unified theoretical basis. To bridge this gap, we pro

summary.core_problem: 在 LVLM 解码器里，attention 与 FFN 通过残差流共同更新表示，但现有分析多是统计归因，缺少统一的、可比较的度量来回答：两类模块到底在“改变表示的什么性质”，以及视觉 token 的注意力交互是否真的在注入有效信息。论文要解决的是：用信息论+几何的统一框架刻画残差更新的“创新(information injection)”与“重配置(entropic reconfiguration)”，并据此诊断 LVLM 的视觉注意力低效问题。
summary.importance: 这更偏机制分析/架构诊断，而不是直接的预训练方法改进。但它给了两个可复用的度量（RID、MixIG）来量化残差更新对表示子空间与信息混合的影响，能用于：比较不同 LVLM 架构、定位视觉 token 融合的瓶颈、以及为后续的架构改造（例如减少无效 cross-attn 计算、调整模块配比）提供证据。对做预训练的人，价值在于把“attention 负责推理、FFN 负责记忆”这类经验说法，变成可测量的几何/熵分解，并指出视觉侧存在系统性冗余。
summary.technical_approach:
论文基于 manifold hypothesis，把残差流表示看作落在某个低维语义流形附近，并把每个子模块产生的残差更新 Δ 写成对表示分布/子空间的几何作用。提出两类指标：
- Representation Information Discrepancy (RID)：用于衡量更新带来的“创新”，即是否引入新的语义方向/扩展表示支持（可理解为对子空间谱结构、复杂度的外延扩张）。
- Mixing Information Gain (MixIG)：用于衡量“重配置”，即在既有支持内对信息进行重新分配/混合的程度（更偏熵意义上的重排，而非新增方向）。
用这套分解去比较 attention update 与 FFN update，得到定量结论：attention 更像子空间保持的算子，主要做 reconfiguration；FFN 更主导 innovation。然后把框架用于 LVLM 的视觉-文本交互，发现 decoder 的视觉 attention 往往没有对问题相关视觉证据做有效 mixing，而是出现高冗余、低信息增益的交互模式（论文用“get lost in attention”概括）。
summary.experiments: 作者在 15 个 LVLM 上做了系统测量，覆盖三类主流架构，并在多模态 benchmark 上评估模块更新的 RID/MixIG 分布与层间变化。核心经验结论是：attention 的贡献主要体现在 MixIG（重配置）而非 RID（创新），FFN 相反；并且在视觉相关的 cross-attention/decoder attention 中，MixIG 也常表现为“低有效混合/高冗余”，说明大量计算没有转化为信息性的表示更新。摘要未给出具体数值；全文的关键在于指标定义、跨模型一致性、以及对视觉注意力冗余的定量证据（例如不同层/不同 token 类型的 RID/MixIG 曲线与对照）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
1) 先读指标定义部分：RID 与 MixIG 的形式化、它们分别对应“创新/重配置”的直觉，以及如何在实际模型激活上估计。
2) 直接跳到“attention vs FFN 分工”的主结果图：看不同模型/不同层是否一致，避免只被个例驱动。
3) 再看“视觉注意力低效”的诊断实验：重点是他们如何定义“问题相关视觉证据”、如何量化冗余，以及是否做了对照（例如文本-only attention、不同视觉 tokenization）。
4) 若时间有限，优先看方法图+两三张主结果图即可；如果要复现/迁移到自家模型，再补实现细节与统计稳健性（不同 prompt、不同任务、不同输入长度下的方差）。

summary_en.core_problem: In LVLM decoders, attention and FFN both write into the same residual stream, yet existing attribution-style analyses lack a unified, theoretically grounded way to compare what each module actually does to representations—especially for visual-token integration. The paper aims to formalize residual updates in terms of (a) injecting new information/semantic directions vs (b) rearranging/mixing existing information, and then use that lens to diagnose why visual attention often underutilizes relevant evidence.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily interpretability and architectural diagnosis rather than a new pretraining recipe. Its practical value is providing reusable metrics (RID, MixIG) to quantify residual-update effects across models and layers, enabling more principled comparisons of LVLM designs and evidence for where visual-token computation is informationally sparse. For pretraining researchers, it turns the informal “attention = reasoning, FFN = memory” narrative into measurable geometric/entropic decompositions and highlights systematic redundancy in visual attention pathways.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Assuming a manifold view of representation space, the paper treats each submodule’s residual update Δ as a geometric operator acting on the residual stream. It introduces:
- Representation Information Discrepancy (RID) to capture “innovation”: whether the update expands the representational support / introduces new semantic directions (often discussed via spectral/subspace changes).
- Mixing Information Gain (MixIG) to capture “reconfiguration”: entropic redistribution and mixing within the existing support, without adding new directions.
Applying these metrics to attention vs FFN updates yields a consistent functional decoupling: attention behaves largely as a subspace-preserving reconfiguration operator, while FFNs dominate innovation. The same framework is then applied to multimodal attention patterns, arguing that decoder visual attention frequently performs redundant interactions with limited informative mixing—hence “getting lost in attention.”
summary_en.experiments: The study reports extensive measurements across 15 LVLMs spanning three major architecture families and multiple multimodal benchmarks. The headline empirical pattern is that attention updates score primarily on MixIG (reconfiguration) rather than RID (innovation), with FFNs showing the opposite trend. For visual-token processing, the metrics indicate substantial redundancy and weak effective mixing over question-relevant visual evidence. The abstract does not expose key numbers; the full paper’s evidence hinges on the consistency of RID/MixIG trends across models/layers and the quantitative diagnostics isolating visual-attention inefficiency.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Read the metric definitions carefully (RID/MixIG) and how they are estimated from activations; this determines whether you can reuse them.
- Jump to the main plots comparing attention vs FFN across depth and across models; check for consistency rather than single-model anecdotes.
- Then read the section diagnosing visual attention: how “relevant visual evidence” is operationalized, what redundancy means quantitatively, and what controls are used.
- If you intend to apply it, follow up on implementation details and robustness checks (task/prompt/input-length variance).

recommendation.en: Only read Section 3 for functional decoupling experiments, the conclusion that attention weights are replaceable provides reference for Transformer architecture simplification.

summary.core_problem: 给 Transformer 的关键组件（多头注意力、FFN/MoE、残差+归一化）提供一个统一的连续时间动力系统解释：把层更新视为在球面流形上的“变分后验加权的条件 score 场”做前向 Euler 离散，从而解释注意力的隐式正则、自校准行为，以及 MoE 为什么更容易塌缩并需要额外平衡损失。
summary.importance:
对预训练研究的直接价值不在于给出可立刻替换的训练目标，而在于提供一个可操作的分析框架：
1) 把注意力看成对“后验加权 score”的核平滑估计，给出注意力为何常表现出自正则/不易塌缩的机制解释；
2) 给出一组由 SVFlow 诱导的可观测量（marginal likelihood、divergence、concentration），并在真实预训练 LM 上验证它们与困惑度/校准的相关性，作为诊断表示质量与层功能分化的工具；
3) 统一了“注意力像核方法/梯度动力学”“残差像 ODE”“归一化像几何投影”等碎片化解释，便于把训练稳定性、校准、MoE 辅助损失等问题放到同一套动力学语言里讨论。
局限也明确：更多是解释与度量，而非新的可验证 scaling law 或显著改进训练配方。
summary.technical_approach:
核心构造是 Score-based Variational Flow (SVFlow)。设观测表示 x、离散潜变量 z（可理解为注意力选择的 token/专家等），给定条件似然 p(x|z;θ) 与变分后验 q(z|x;ϕ)，定义连续时间 ODE 的向量场为：对每个 z 的条件 score ∇x log p(x|z) 做 q(z|x) 加权平均。直觉上是“在不确定的离散选择下，沿着条件对数似然上升方向做动态滤波”。

把该框架落到 Transformer：
- 几何：由于 LayerNorm/RMSNorm 使表示近似定范数，作者把状态空间放到球面流形 S^{d-1}，并讨论切空间更新与 retraction（近似指数映射）。
- 离散化：对球面 SVFlow 做 forward Euler 离散，得到“x_{l+1}=Retract(x_l + step * v(x_l))”形式；对应到实现上就是残差连接 + RMSNorm 近似 retraction。
- 注意力对应：多头注意力被解释为用 von Mises–Fisher (vMF) 核对后验 q(z|x) 做平滑，从而近似 SVFlow 的向量场；多头则是多个核/子空间的并行近似。
- FFN/MoE 对应：FFN/MoE 被解释为对同一向量场的“松弛的网络近似”（不再显式核平滑/后验结构），因此更依赖额外约束；这也被用来解释 MoE 需要 load-balancing 等辅助损失以避免专家塌缩。
- 正则化与一致性：SVFlow 自带一个变分一致性（variational consistency）视角，作者用它来解释注意力后验的隐式自正则，并提出可用于探针分析的度量（marginal likelihood、divergence、concentration）。

整体上，这篇文章的“创新点”主要是：把 Transformer 的模块级结构与一个具体的连续时间变分 score 流严格对齐（至少在球面+Euler 离散设定下），并给出一套可落地的内部度量来做实证分析，而不是停留在类比。
summary.experiments:
实验以“前缀打乱（prefix-shuffling）逐步破坏上下文”的干预方式，在预训练语言模型上观察注意力层的 SVFlow 诱导度量与外部性能指标的关系。作者报告的关键结论包括：
- marginal likelihood 与预测困惑度、校准指标呈强相关，可作为表示质量的代理信号；
- 深层注意力对上下文破坏更敏感，显示出明显的深度分工/专门化；
- divergence 与 concentration 的组合刻画了注意力内部动力学的不同工作区间，并对应到不同模型的校准差异。

泛读建议（约 40–60 分钟）：
1) 先看方法主线：SVFlow 定义（向量场=后验加权条件 score）以及为什么要上球面流形；把“z 是离散潜变量”与“注意力选择 token / MoE 选择专家”的对应关系想清楚。
2) 再看“Euler 离散→Transformer 组件”的对齐段落：注意力为何对应 vMF 核平滑、RMSNorm+残差为何对应 retraction。
3) 最后看实验：重点看 prefix-shuffling 的设计、marginal likelihood 与 PPL/校准的相关性图，以及 divergence/concentration 划分出的 regimes。读到这里基本能判断这些度量是否能迁移到你自己的训练诊断里。

如果只想拿走可用的东西：优先关注 SVFlow 诱导的度量定义与它们在层间/模型间的可解释差异，而不是几何推导的全部细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Provide a unified continuous-time dynamical interpretation of core Transformer blocks—MHA, FFN/MoE, residual + normalization—by introducing Score-based Variational Flow (SVFlow) on a spherical manifold and showing that a forward Euler discretization recovers the Transformer update structure. The goal is to explain implicit regularization in attention, calibration behavior, and why MoE tends to collapse without auxiliary balancing losses.
summary_en.importance:
The main value for foundation-model pretraining is diagnostic and mechanistic rather than an immediately deployable new objective:
- It turns several partial stories (attention as kernels, residuals as ODEs, normalization as projection) into one coherent dynamical system.
- It proposes SVFlow-induced observables (marginal likelihood, divergence, concentration) and empirically links them to perplexity and calibration under controlled context corruption, suggesting practical probes for representation quality and depth-wise specialization.
- It offers a concrete explanation for the asymmetry between attention (often self-regularizing) and MoE (often requiring explicit load-balancing).
The limitation is that it is primarily an interpretability/analysis framework; it does not, from the provided content, establish new scaling laws or a training recipe with clear downstream gains.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SVFlow defines an ODE whose vector field is a variational-posterior-weighted average of conditional score functions. With a discrete latent z and likelihood p(x|z;θ), plus variational posterior q(z|x;ϕ), the flow direction at x is E_{q(z|x)}[∇_x log p(x|z)]. Intuitively, it is likelihood-ascent under uncertain discrete selection.

Mapping to Transformers:
- Geometry: because LayerNorm/RMSNorm keeps representations near constant norm, the state is modeled on a sphere S^{d-1}; updates live in the tangent space and are mapped back via a retraction.
- Discretization: forward Euler on spherical SVFlow yields a residual-style step followed by a relaxed retraction, aligning with residual + RMSNorm blocks.
- Attention: MHA is interpreted as approximating the SVFlow vector field via a von Mises–Fisher kernel-smoothed posterior; multi-head corresponds to multiple such approximations in parallel subspaces.
- FFN/MoE: FFN/MoE approximates the same vector field in a more relaxed, network-based manner, which motivates why MoE may need explicit balancing to avoid degenerate posterior/expert usage.
- Regularization lens: a variational-consistency view is used to argue for implicit self-regularization in attention posteriors and to derive internal metrics (marginal likelihood, divergence, concentration) for probing model dynamics.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical validation uses a prefix-shuffling intervention that progressively degrades context in pretrained LMs, then studies how SVFlow-induced metrics track external quality measures.
Reported takeaways:
- SVFlow marginal likelihood correlates strongly with predictive perplexity and calibration, acting as a proxy for representation quality.
- Deeper attention layers are substantially more sensitive to context disruption, consistent with depth-dependent specialization.
- The interaction of divergence and concentration reveals distinct internal regimes that align with calibration differences across models.

Skim plan (40–60 min):
1) Read the SVFlow definition carefully (posterior-weighted conditional scores) and the role of the discrete latent z.
2) Focus on the “Euler discretization on the sphere → Transformer blocks” correspondence: vMF smoothing for attention; residual+RMSNorm as relaxed retraction.
3) Jump to experiments: understand prefix-shuffling, then inspect plots linking marginal likelihood to PPL/calibration and the divergence–concentration regime analysis.

If you only want actionable content, prioritize the metric definitions and how they behave across layers/models under controlled context corruption.

paper.title: Transformers Learn Latent Mixture Models In-Context via Mirror Descent

summary.core_problem: 解释Transformer注意力在序列建模中如何“从上下文中”学习潜在的token重要性/混合权重，并给出可证明的机制对应。
summary.importance: 贡献类型为原理机制分析与可证明构造：把token重要性估计形式化为带潜变量的混合转移分布（Mixture of Transition Distributions）上的ICL问题，并证明一个小型Transformer可精确实现Mirror Descent一步更新，从而将ICL与在线优化/贝叶斯近似联系起来。
summary.technical_approach: 提出一个潜变量控制历史token影响的生成框架，潜变量分布由未知混合权重参数化；给出三层Transformer的显式构造，使其在前向传播中实现一次Mirror Descent来从上下文估计混合权重；并证明该估计器是一阶近似的Bayes-optimal predictor（在其设定下）。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供具体实验细节（参数规模、数据、基线与量化结果未披露）；主要以理论构造与证明为主，并声称有实验/实证来佐证构造与学习机制（但摘要截断，无法确认具体设置与提升幅度）。

summary_en.core_problem: To explain how Transformers can infer latent token importance/mixture weights from context in sequence modeling, and to establish a provable correspondence between attention-based in-context learning and an explicit optimization update.
summary_en.importance: Provides a constructive, provable mechanism linking in-context learning to online optimization/Bayesian inference: it formalizes ICL as learning mixture weights in a latent-variable mixture of transition distributions and shows a small Transformer can exactly implement a mirror-descent update, yielding a first-order Bayes-optimal predictor in the setting.
summary_en.technical_approach: Defines a generative framework where a latent variable controls historical-token influence and is governed by unknown mixture weights. Constructs an explicit three-layer Transformer whose forward pass performs one step of mirror descent to estimate these weights from context, and proves the resulting predictor matches a first-order approximation to the Bayes-optimal estimator under the model assumptions.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract provides no concrete experimental details (model sizes, datasets, baselines, or quantitative gains). It suggests empirical support for the construction/mechanism but does not specify the setup or results.

recommendation.zh: 证明“小Transformer=一步mirror descent”很漂亮但构造味重、外推到大模型需谨慎；只看定理假设与实现电路那一节，拿来做理论对照即可。
recommendation.en: The “tiny Transformer implements one-step mirror descent” proof is elegant but quite constructive, so extrapolation to real LMs is shaky; read the theorem assumptions and the circuit realization section as a theory touchstone.
